guardrails: Baen quarry sources explicitly state 20–40 ton standard heavy-stone wagon loads. Do not overwrite that campaign fact with historical Conestoga payload.

Because 20–40 tons materially exceeds ordinary historical horse-wagon benchmarks, Baen quarry-wagon team size, running gear, grade limits and sustained speed must be recovered or engineered explicitly before capacity calculation.
External comparators may validate or constrain a model; they do not create a current fleet count.
